required_findings.criteria: Identifies that apps targeting SDK 36 on Android 16 no longer receive onBackPressed, so system back (including TalkBack, keyboard, and Switch Access back) cannot dismiss the notice as intended, and recommends OnBackInvokedDispatcher/OnBackPressedDispatcher callbacks.

Identifies announceForAccessibility on every keystroke as noisy and deprecated on recent Android versions, and recommends exposing the count as state, a debounced polite live region, or no announcement.

Identifies that the visibly unmasked one-time code is marked as a password input only to obtain a numeric keyboard, which makes accessibility services treat it as a password, and recommends a plain numeric input type with a one-time-code autofill hint.
Requires verification of back dismissal and code entry on an Android 16 device with TalkBack and with a keyboard or Switch Access.

forbidden_claims: Claims onBackPressed still works unchanged for apps targeting SDK 36
Recommends requesting READ_SMS to fill the code
Claims exact TalkBack speech without device evidence
